title: Meet True and False
heading: Meet True and False
description: Python calls these two values booleans. A comparison produces a boolean, just as a calculation produces a number.

scene.label: Python output for the number guessing game.

feedback.initial: Predict what will happen, then press Run.
feedback.success: Change one value and run again. Can you explain the result?
feedback.empty: Nothing was printed. Was the condition False? Try another guess.

explanation.title: Questions have values too
explanation.text: Use capital T and F. True and False are values, without quotes. "True" is text.

explanation.title: Store a number; ask a question
explanation.text: One = stores a value under a name. Two == compare values. The second line does not change guess.
